_comment: Deployed contracts on which a rule once reported something that is not there. Each entry names the rule that must stay silent on that contract and says why the finding was wrong.

classic_85deeaf2.why: the three-word transfer lowers the named account only on the branch where that account is the caller, and leaves without reverting otherwise

classic_f8784090.why: transferFrom leaves the allowance as it is and adds what it moved to a second record keyed by holder and caller, and refuses once that record would pass the allowance
